entries.summary: K8 exports ./l-test-host (src/l-test-host.test-support.ts), an L test Host built only from the published packages: an embedded SQLite server, a paired daemon with a stub runtime that submits the result document, and the HostLedger. The K8 routine and delivery vectors run on it instead of the K4 openHost, so a Host that vendors K8 can run them too (#1325). The K8 rules and their runtime behavior do not change; a Host that vendored K8 copies the new file with the two contract tests, as src/VENDOR.md Layer 3 lists.
